Complete path proof plus nine full plaza cells and ten mixed masks are recorded in better-archive-town-path-proof.json and better-archive-plaza-proof.json. Sign and fountain water are excluded. Fresh Thor qualification required; previous invalid patch and exact-build visual failures remain rejected.
